subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should progress mode make the full five-second gate universal and enable model-preamble headlines by default on Discord and Telegram without a new configuration option?
rationale: The PR fixes a real eager-start problem but also changes the default cross-channel progress experience and adds durable plugin SDK lifecycle surface, which requires explicit product/API ownership rather than an automated merge decision.

options.title: Approve combined direction
options.body: Accept the universal time gate and default typed-preamble headline, then merge after exact-head Telegram proof and remaining checks are inspectable.

options.title: Narrow to time gating
options.body: Land only the removal of the second-event fast start and defer the headline and SDK lifecycle additions to a separately approved change.

options.title: Keep current defaults
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers choose a broader progress-draft UX and external plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Approve combined direction
recommendation.body: Accept the universal time gate and default typed-preamble headline, then merge after exact-head Telegram proof and remaining checks are inspectable.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete and the linked issue establishes the combined product direction under a protected maintainer label.
